ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Contemporary Art. This class investigates the history of contemporary art as it unfolds in real time. We will examine the key issues, institutions, and events that have shaped how and where contemporary art is made, displayed, encountered, and critiqued. Above all, our attention will center on the artistic and political engagements that inform contemporary practices, from the legacies of twentieth century art-making to the fluctuations of global financial markets. Enrollment is open to all undergraduates -- no prior knowledge of art history is required.
